Title: Priority transition
ReporterMessage: Thanks for raising this. Settings, Priorities now has a Change for next year button. For each pillar and sub-pillar you choose whether it continues, becomes another or ends, and the priorities follow by themselves, merges included. We could not reproduce the blank 2027 view you saw. If it appears again, please report it with a screenshot.
InternalNote: Year-change panel, tested on dev (R2 tests 3 to 6). The reported 2027 view with no pillar row was never reproduced; cause unknown.

Title: Adding pillars
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. When you add a pillar or sub-pillar in Settings, Priorities, the cursor now stays in the new row and the page no longer jumps to the bottom of the list. No action needed.
InternalNote: The cursor went to the last sub-pillar box in the whole list. Tested on dev (R2 test 1).

Title: Metal Delivery process areas incorrect
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Two process areas shared one name and the ingestion grid picked the wrong one. That is fixed, so no new documents will be tagged under the wrong area. The documents already tagged wrongly will be corrected once the bulk change tool arrives in the next release. Nothing for you to do.
InternalNote: Terms now read by id. BSL process-tree repair and re-tagging owed after N3 (R4). Filter tested on dev (R1 test 6).

Title: Documents open at the bottom
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. A document's preview now opens at page 1 instead of at the bottom. No action needed. If you still see a document open at the end, please tell us which one.
InternalNote: Cause not found; the preview now asks for page 1. Converted files only. Tested on dev (R1 test 7). Check in production after release.

Title: Reviews not marking as complete
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Review complete now records your review and the card shows it as done. Pressing it a second time in the same round is refused with a clear message, and each version's comment now shows under its row in the history. No action needed.
InternalNote: The review check read comments from one place; it now reads all three. Which place production uses is not known. Tested on dev (R1 test 3). Reviewer seats go to UAT untested.

Title: Completion of review
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. When a step is refused because the document is open in Word, the app now says so plainly and says who has it open. Close the document in Word, including any other tab, then press the button again.
InternalNote: Word's lock on an open file read as an app fault. Tested on dev (R1 test 4).

Title: Review status not updating
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. It was the same fault as another report and is now fixed: Review complete records the review and the status updates. The Teams message to the next person now also sends by itself, with no second press needed.
InternalNote: Same fault as report 13, plus the hand-over message. Tested on dev (R1 tests 3 and 5).

Title: I declined an edit request and now the document is checked out to me
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. If a step is refused part-way, the app now gives back the check-out it took, so the document is not left checked out to you, and it says that nothing was changed. We have not yet found why the step was refused in the first place. If it happens again, please send us the message word for word.
InternalNote: Release of a taken check-out is unit-tested only; it could not be forced on dev. Why Approve failed on the edit request is unexplained.

Title: Tracked changes are not showing for the approver
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. The preview cannot show tracked changes, so the review and approval card now says so and has an Open in Word button. Word opens the document for viewing with the tracked changes visible.
InternalNote: The preview is a PDF with changes applied. Open in Word uses the viewing mode. Tested on dev (R1 test 7).

Title: Message not sent to reviewer
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. Every hand-over step now sends its Teams message as soon as the step is done, including to reviewers added in the dialog. You no longer need to press Send, and Send again is there if you want it.
InternalNote: The send plan was empty when reviewers were added in the dialog. Tested on dev (R1 tests 3 and 5).

Title: UAT DOC-040: Cancel a revision
ReporterMessage: Thanks for testing this. The app behaved correctly: cancelling a revision that was only started returns the document to its last published version and leaves no new version or comment. The test script did not describe that case. UAT-DOC-040 now does, so please run it again from the new steps.
InternalNote: Script corrected in v0.100.0. Open risk, never run: Cancel revision on a document with two approved versions.

Title: Rolling over priority initiative to continue into another year fault
ReporterMessage: Thanks for reporting this. A priority past its planned end now has Extend in its menu, which carries it into the year you are viewing in two clicks. In the form, changing the start year now keeps the sub-pillar instead of blanking it, so Save is no longer held.
InternalNote: Extend and the two form fixes. Tested on dev (R2 tests 7 and 8).
